declaration.negotiation_history_statement: Whitcombe Reyes LLP negotiated the settlement directly with Brightline’s counsel. We initially proposed a $36 million class fund with automatic payments, plus $7 million in fees and expenses subject to court approval. Brightline responded that this exceeded its settlement authority and offered a $28 million class fund with automatic payments, plus $4 million in court-approved fees and expenses. We accepted that offer. Both proposals provided that any fees not awarded by the Court would go to the class, and neither included a clear-sailing provision. Fees were discussed in the initial proposal, not deferred until after agreement on class relief. The settlement will provide automatic payments to identified class members without requiring claims. In my assessment, the $28 million fund offers substantial, prompt relief in light of the risks of class certification and trial, and the delay of further litigation. The proposed fee remains subject to the Court’s independent review.
